carnivore.name: Bacon and Eggs, the Classic
carnivore.method: Fry the bacon, then cook the eggs in the bacon fat until the whites are set.

carnivore.name: Butter-Basted Scramble
carnivore.method: Scramble the eggs low and slow in plenty of butter, salt at the end.

carnivore.name: Steak and Eggs
carnivore.method: Sear the strip steak 3 minutes a side, fry two eggs in the pan juices.

carnivore.name: Ground Beef Breakfast Bowl
carnivore.method: Brown the beef with salt, crack the eggs in for the last two minutes and stir.

carnivore.name: Liver and Eggs Power Start
carnivore.method: Dust the liver with salt, sear fast in butter, serve with fried eggs.

carnivore.name: Cheesy Egg Plate
carnivore.method: Fry the eggs in butter and melt the cheddar over the top before serving.

carnivore.name: Double Burger Patties with Cheese
carnivore.method: Form two patties, salt well, sear hard, and melt the cheddar on top.

carnivore.name: Leftover Roast and Butter
carnivore.method: Reheat last night's roast in a pan with butter until the edges crisp.

carnivore.name: Tuna and Egg Salad Bowl
carnivore.method: Flake the tuna, chop the boiled eggs, bind with soft butter and salt.

carnivore.name: Sardine Protein Plate
carnivore.method: Sardines straight from the tin with boiled eggs and a good pinch of salt.

carnivore.name: Bone Broth Beef Cup
carnivore.method: Simmer the cooked ground beef in hot bone broth, salt to taste, eat like stew.

carnivore.name: Chicken Thighs, Crispy Skin
carnivore.method: Roast the thighs skin-side up at 425F until the skin crackles, about 35 minutes.

carnivore.name: The Ribeye Night
carnivore.method: Salt the ribeye an hour ahead, sear in tallow 4 minutes a side, rest 5.

carnivore.name: Slow Cooker Chuck Roast
carnivore.method: Salt the roast, 8 hours on low, shred and pour the juices back over.

carnivore.name: Crispy Pork Shoulder
carnivore.method: Roast low and slow until pull-apart, then broil 5 minutes for crackling.

carnivore.name: Butter Salmon Fillet
carnivore.method: Pan-sear skin-side down in butter, baste the top, done in 8 minutes.

carnivore.name: Lamb Shoulder Chops
carnivore.method: Sear the chops hard in tallow, finish with a butter baste and flaky salt.

carnivore.name: Beef Short Ribs, Oven Style
carnivore.method: Salt heavily, cover and roast at 300F for 3 hours until the bones slide out.

carnivore.name: Brisket Plate
carnivore.method: Reheat sliced brisket in its own fat, stack it high, salt to finish.

carnivore.name: Burger Steak with Fried Eggs
carnivore.method: One giant salted patty seared in tallow, topped with two fried eggs.

lion.name: Ribeye, Salted Well
lion.method: Salt an hour ahead, sear in tallow 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes.

lion.name: Ground Beef Bowl
lion.method: Brown the beef in tallow with salt, eat it hot from the bowl.

lion.name: Slow Chuck Roast
lion.method: Salt, slow-cook 8 hours, shred, and pour the tallow-rich juices back over.

lion.name: NY Strip and Broth
lion.method: Sear the strip in tallow and sip hot salted beef bone broth alongside.

lion.name: Short Ribs, Fall-Apart
lion.method: Covered roast at 300F for 3 hours; the fat is the point, eat it.

lion.name: Brisket and Tallow
lion.method: Slices reheated in tallow until the edges crisp, salted twice.

lion.name: Double Burger Steaks
lion.method: Two thick salted patties seared hard in tallow, rested a few minutes.

lion.name: Lamb Shoulder Night
lion.method: Lamb is a ruminant and it counts: sear the shoulder chops in tallow, salt well.
